prompt:
You are a sceptical financial analyst reviewing a forecast prepared by a colleague.

Given the following forecast for VINDHYATEL (base year 2021):
{
  "strategy": "alt_strategy",
  "base_year": 2021,
  "anomaly_detected": true,
  "forecast": [
    {
      "year": 2022,
      "revenue_cr": 16522,
      "net_income_cr": 2970,
      "eps": 250.5
    },
    {
      "year": 2023,
      "revenue_cr": 18174,
      "net_income_cr": 3267,
      "eps": 275.6
    },
    {
      "year": 2024,
      "revenue_cr": 19810,
      "net_income_cr": 3540,
      "eps": 298.6
    }
  ],
  "top_assumptions": [
    "Revenue recovery assumed at ~10% CAGR over FY2022-2024 from FY2021 base, driven by mean-reversion toward pre-COVID trend as EPC order book (unsatisfied performance obligations of ~60,707 lakhs as at March 2021) executes and domestic broadband/OFC demand accelerates; the -20.24% revenue decline in FY2021 is treated as anomalous COVID disruption rather than a structural decline.",
    "Net profit margin maintained at approximately 17-18% of revenue (consistent with consolidated PAT of ~27,008 lakhs on revenue of ~150,206 lakhs in FY2021, noting that a significant portion of consolidated PAT is contributed by equity-accounted associates like Birla Corporation, which are expected to sustain performance); EPS computed on ~1,185 lakh shares outstanding."
  ],
  "reasoning": "FY2021 revenue declined 20.24% YoY to INR 150,206 lakhs (INR 15,021 crores) due to COVID-19 disruption, making the latest year-on-year change anomalous and unreliable as a projection basis. With only two years of P&L data available in the report (FY2020 and FY2021), a formal multi-year CAGR cannot be computed, so the forecast assumes mean-reversion: revenue recovers toward and beyond FY2020 levels (INR 18,832 crores) over FY2022-FY2024 at roughly 10% per annum, supported by management commentary on strong OFC/broadband demand, EPC pipeline (~INR 6,071 crores in remaining performance obligations), and capex of INR 483 crores in FY2021 on OFC capacity expansion. Net profit is projected broadly in line with FY2021 consolidated PAT margins (~18%), acknowledging that associate company contributions (particularly Birla Corporation's highest-ever profitability) provide a stable earnings base; the gearing ratio improved to 19.96% at the consolidated level, indicating balance-sheet capacity to support growth."
}

Step 1: Identify the 3 most critical assumptions embedded in this forecast.
Step 2: For each assumption, describe one plausible scenario where it fails.
Step 3: Rate each assumption failure as Low / Medium / High risk to the forecast accuracy.
Step 4: Assign an overall confidence score from 0-100 (100 = completely certain).

RESPONSE FORMAT: Begin your response DIRECTLY with the opening brace { — no reasoning or text before the JSON.

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "company": "<COMPANY>",
  "base_year": <YYYY>,
  "strategy": "<baseline|alt_strategy>",
  "assumptions": [
    {"assumption": "<text>", "failure_scenario": "<text>", "risk": "<Low|Medium|High>"}
  ],
  "confidence_score": <0-100>,
  "overall_critique": "<2 sentences>"
}
